cards.difficultyReason: Широко понятное взрослым понятие или короткое содержательное различение на конкретном примере; специальный философский аппарат не требуется.
cards.authorRead: Full card and necessary complete source contexts personally read; complete bodies saved.
cards.changeReason: Coherent rewrite of all fields. Concrete examples and independent extra facts in correct notes; ID/order/integer key preserved.83replaces unsupported false-dilemma source pairing with an independent equivocation example supported by full source.
cards.fixReason: Author found keyed note too close to prompt. Replace it with independently supported history and lack-of-consensus fact; no MAIN/other-option change.

directedOnly: Only80 correct-note supplemental fact; remainingcardbytes unchanged. One directed fix cycle after author self-finding. No third full review.
